reasons: Both answers rest mainly on an exaggerated difference in degree of certainty, but B at least says that «вряд ли» is more conversational and «едва ли» more bookish, and it separates «едва» meaning 'barely' from «едва ли». A never mentions register or «едва»/«едва ли не», and its exercise is broken: «___ ли ты будешь» would produce «вряд ли ли» and also contains English text. B's examples and exercise are usable at B1, although its «вряд» mnemonic is nonsense.

A: Presents a strict certainty scale (70-80% vs 95-99%) as the core difference, while the main real difference is register (neutral vs bookish)
Claims «вряд ли не придёт» is ungrammatical; «вряд ли не» constructions are possible
Exercise template '___ ли ты будешь' yields the malformed «вряд ли ли» / «едва ли ли»
B: Overstates certainty difference as the primary distinction
«Практически не придёт» presented as a natural paraphrase is awkward
